title: Cash Pickup Tier Entry Requirements and Accepted Funding Methods
content:
Each Cash Pickup tier sets three entry figures: the lowest Personal Sender Account level that may book it, the fewest completed personal transfers the account must already have, and the funding methods the tier accepts. The account's own level may narrow the funding methods further.

## Entry schedule by tier

| Cash Pickup tier | Lowest account level that may book | Completed personal transfers needed before booking | Funding methods the tier accepts |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | Paloma Starter | 0 | ACH debit |
| Cash Pickup Express | Paloma Starter | 0 | debit card, credit card, pay-by-bank |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | Paloma Verified Plus | 5 | debit card, credit card, pay-by-bank |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | Paloma Verified | 0 | ACH debit, debit card, pay-by-bank |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | Paloma Verified | 0 | debit card, pay-by-bank |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | Paloma Enhanced | 5 | wire, pay-by-bank |

## Reading the schedule

- **Account level.** The figure is the lowest Personal Sender Account level, by its official name, from which the tier may be booked.
- **Completed transfers.** The figure is a count of completed personal transfers on the account. A figure of 0 means no history is needed.
- **Funding methods.** The list is everything the tier accepts. A method absent from a tier's list is not accepted on that tier. Credit cards are accepted only on Cash Pickup Express and Cash Pickup Express Plus, and wires only on Cash Pickup Large Amount.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical accounts)

- A hypothetical Paloma Verified Plus account with 4 completed personal transfers does not meet the Cash Pickup Express Plus figure of 5. The same account with 5 completed transfers meets it, because the figure is a minimum and 5 reaches it.
- A hypothetical customer who wants to pay by wire can only do so on Cash Pickup Large Amount. No other Cash Pickup tier lists wire.
- A hypothetical customer who wants to pay by ACH debit has two tiers listing that method: Cash Pickup Economy and Cash Pickup Bank Branch.
